data.gender_notes: Hisein is used as a male name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic word ‘hādī’ meaning ‘guide’. The name Hisein signifies a successor or substitute, often used to refer to Prophet ‘Īsā (as) in Islamic tradition as the prophesied substitute of Prophet Muḥammad (pbuh). The name Hisein carries the meaning “Successor, Substitute” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Hisein usually hope their child will grow to embody successor, substitute and live with faith, good character and purpose.

data.cultural_impact: In the context of the Islamic traditions, Hisein is a significant name as it is used to refer to Imam Ali ibn Abi Talib (ra), the fourth Caliph and the cousin and son-in-law of Prophet Muhammad (pbuh). His name evokes the idea of a righteous and just leader who serves as a guide and protector for his people (the Ummah).
data.spiritual_significance: In Islamic spirituality, the name Hisein takes on a profound meaning as it represents the concept of a guide, whether it refers to Prophet ‘Īsā (as), Prophet Ali (ra), or the spiritual guides of the individual believer. The name evokes the idea of following the path of God and seeking guidance from divine sources. It serves as a reminder that every individual is on a spiritual journey and in need of a guide to navigate the complexities of life. In this sense, the name Hisein is a powerful reminder of the importance of righteous leadership and spiritual guidance in the lives of Muslims.
